&amp;lt;body class="bg-fantasy-bg text-fantasy-text font-sans min-h-full flex flex-col selection:bg-fantasy-crimson selection:text-white"&amp;gt;

    &amp;lt;!-- Navbar Header --&amp;gt;
    &amp;lt;header class="bg-fantasy-card border-b border-fantasy-border sticky top-0 z-40 shadow-xl"&amp;gt;
        &amp;lt;div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8"&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;div class="flex items-center justify-between h-16"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;!-- Logo / Title --&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div class="flex items-center space-x-3 cursor-pointer" onclick="navigateTo('')"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-fantasy-crimson/20 border border-fantasy-crimson flex items-center justify-center text-fantasy-gold shadow-md"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-dice-d20 text-xl animate-pulse"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;div&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span class="font-cinzel text-xl font-bold tracking-wider gold-gradient-text block leading-none"&amp;gt;ARCANE&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span class="text-[10px] tracking-widest text-fantasy-muted uppercase font-semibold"&amp;gt;Compendio TTRPG&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

                &amp;lt;!-- Navigation Tabs (Desktop) --&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;nav class="hidden md:flex space-x-1 lg:space-x-2"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;button onclick="navigateTo('')" id="nav-home" class="nav-btn px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-200 flex items-center space-x-2 bg-fantasy-crimson text-white shadow"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-house text-xs"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Dashboard&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;button onclick="navigateTo('dice')" id="nav-dice" class="nav-btn px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-200 flex items-center space-x-2 text-fantasy-muted hover:text-white hover:bg-fantasy-hover"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-dice text-xs"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Lancia Dadi&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;button onclick="navigateTo('initiative')" id="nav-initiative" class="nav-btn px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-200 flex items-center space-x-2 text-fantasy-muted hover:text-white hover:bg-fantasy-hover"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-shield-halved text-xs"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Iniziativa&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;button onclick="navigateTo('names')" id="nav-names" class="nav-btn px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-200 flex items-center space-x-2 text-fantasy-muted hover:text-white hover:bg-fantasy-hover"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-user-ninja text-xs"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Generatore NPG&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;button onclick="navigateTo('notes')" id="nav-notes" class="nav-btn px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-200 flex items-center space-x-2 text-fantasy-muted hover:text-white hover:bg-fantasy-hover"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-book-bookmark text-xs"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Scratchpad DM&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/nav&amp;gt;

                &amp;lt;!-- Actions Right (GitHub Export) --&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div class="flex items-center space-x-3"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;button onclick="openExportModal()" class="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-fantasy-gold/40 text-fantasy-gold hover:bg-fantasy-gold/10 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center space-x-2 transition-all"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-file-export"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span class="hidden sm:inline"&amp;gt;Esporta per GitHub&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
                    
                    &amp;lt;!-- Mobile Menu Button --&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;button onclick="toggleMobileMenu()" class="md:hidden p-2 rounded-md text-fantasy-muted hover:text-white hover:bg-fantasy-hover focus:outline-none"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-bars text-xl" id="menu-icon"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

        &amp;lt;!-- Mobile Menu Dropdown --&amp;gt;
        &amp;lt;div id="mobile-menu" class="hidden md:hidden border-b border-fantasy-border bg-fantasy-card px-4 pt-2 pb-4 space-y-1"&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;button onclick="navigateTo('')" class="mobile-nav-btn w-full text-left px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-base font-medium flex items-center space-x-3"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-house w-5 text-center"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt; &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Dashboard&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;button onclick="navigateTo('dice')" class="mobile-nav-btn w-full text-left px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-base font-medium flex items-center space-x-3"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-dice w-5 text-center"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt; &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Lancia Dadi Avanzato&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;button onclick="navigateTo('initiative')" class="mobile-nav-btn w-full text-left px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-base font-medium flex items-center space-x-3"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-shield-halved w-5 text-center"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt; &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Iniziativa &amp;amp;amp; Turni&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;button onclick="navigateTo('names')" class="mobile-nav-btn w-full text-left px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-base font-medium flex items-center space-x-3"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-user-ninja w-5 text-center"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt; &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Generatore NPG &amp;amp;amp; Nomi&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;button onclick="navigateTo('notes')" class="mobile-nav-btn w-full text-left px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-base font-medium flex items-center space-x-3"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-book-bookmark w-5 text-center"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt; &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Scratchpad Master&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
    &amp;lt;/header&amp;gt;

    &amp;lt;!-- Main Content Area --&amp;gt;
    &amp;lt;main class="flex-grow max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8"&amp;gt;

        &amp;lt;!-- ================= PAGE 1: HOME / DASHBOARD ================= --&amp;gt;
        &amp;lt;section id="view-home" class="app-view space-y-8"&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;!-- Hero Header --&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;div class="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-fantasy-card via-fantasy-card to-fantasy-hover border border-fantasy-border p-6 sm:p-10 shadow-2xl"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div class="absolute -right-10 -bottom-10 opacity-10 text-fantasy-gold pointer-events-none"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-dragon text-[240px]"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div class="relative z-10 max-w-2xl space-y-4"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;div class="inline-flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-fantasy-crimson/20 border border-fantasy-crimson/40 text-fantasy-crimsonLight text-xs font-semibold"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-sparkles"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Compendio TTRPG Pronto all'Uso&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;h1 class="font-cinzel text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white"&amp;gt;
                        Strumenti d'Elite per il &amp;lt;span class="gold-gradient-text"&amp;gt;Dungeon Master&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/h1&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;p class="text-fantasy-muted text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed"&amp;gt;
                        Accedi velocemente a tutte le utilità necessarie per gestire le tue sessioni di D&amp;amp;amp;D, Pathfinder o qualsiasi gioco di ruolo da tavolo. Semplice, veloce e ottimizzato per mobile e desktop.
                    &amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

            &amp;lt;!-- Utilities Grid --&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;!-- Card 1: Dice --&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div onclick="navigateTo('dice')" class="group cursor-pointer bg-fantasy-card border border-fantasy-border hover:border-fantasy-gold/60 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 flex flex-col justify-between"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;div class="space-y-4"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-lg bg-fantasy-crimson/20 border border-fantasy-crimson/40 flex items-center justify-center text-fantasy-gold group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform"&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-dice-d20 text-2xl"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;h3 class="font-cinzel text-xl font-bold text-white group-hover:text-fantasy-gold transition-colors"&amp;gt;Lancia Dadi&amp;lt;/h3&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted leading-relaxed"&amp;gt;
                            Lanci singoli e multipli, gestione modificatori, calcolo automatico di Vantaggio / Svantaggio e cronologia dettagliata.
                        &amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;div class="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-fantasy-border/50 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-fantasy-gold"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Apri Utilità&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

                &amp;lt;!-- Card 2: Initiative --&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div onclick="navigateTo('initiative')" class="group cursor-pointer bg-fantasy-card border border-fantasy-border hover:border-fantasy-gold/60 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 flex flex-col justify-between"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;div class="space-y-4"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-lg bg-fantasy-crimson/20 border border-fantasy-crimson/40 flex items-center justify-center text-fantasy-gold group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform"&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-shield-halved text-2xl"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;h3 class="font-cinzel text-xl font-bold text-white group-hover:text-fantasy-gold transition-colors"&amp;gt;Iniziativa &amp;amp;amp; Turni&amp;lt;/h3&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted leading-relaxed"&amp;gt;
                            Gestisci il combattimento: ordine d'iniziativa dinamico, tracciamento HP, contatore di round e ordinamento rapido.
                        &amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;div class="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-fantasy-border/50 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-fantasy-gold"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Apri Utilità&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

                &amp;lt;!-- Card 3: Names &amp;amp; NPCs --&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div onclick="navigateTo('names')" class="group cursor-pointer bg-fantasy-card border border-fantasy-border hover:border-fantasy-gold/60 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 flex flex-col justify-between"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;div class="space-y-4"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-lg bg-fantasy-crimson/20 border border-fantasy-crimson/40 flex items-center justify-center text-fantasy-gold group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform"&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-user-ninja text-2xl"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;h3 class="font-cinzel text-xl font-bold text-white group-hover:text-fantasy-gold transition-colors"&amp;gt;Generatore NPG&amp;lt;/h3&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted leading-relaxed"&amp;gt;
                            Genera all'istante nomi diviso per razze (Umani, Elfi, Nani, Orchi) e profili psicologici per NPG completi di tratti e segreti.
                        &amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;div class="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-fantasy-border/50 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-fantasy-gold"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Apri Utilità&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

                &amp;lt;!-- Card 4: DM Scratchpad --&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div onclick="navigateTo('notes')" class="group cursor-pointer bg-fantasy-card border border-fantasy-border hover:border-fantasy-gold/60 p-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 flex flex-col justify-between"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;div class="space-y-4"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;div class="w-12 h-12 rounded-lg bg-fantasy-crimson/20 border border-fantasy-crimson/40 flex items-center justify-center text-fantasy-gold group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform"&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-book-bookmark text-2xl"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;h3 class="font-cinzel text-xl font-bold text-white group-hover:text-fantasy-gold transition-colors"&amp;gt;Scratchpad DM&amp;lt;/h3&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted leading-relaxed"&amp;gt;
                            Tieni traccia delle tue idee di sessione, schede veloci, luoghi e appunti con salvataggio automatico sul browser.
                        &amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;div class="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-fantasy-border/50 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-semibold text-fantasy-gold"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Apri Utilità&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

            &amp;lt;!-- GitHub Export Info Banner --&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;div class="bg-fantasy-card/60 border border-fantasy-border rounded-xl p-5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div class="flex items-center space-x-4"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;div class="text-fantasy-gold text-2xl pl-2"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;i class="fa-brands fa-github"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;div&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;h4 class="font-bold text-sm text-white"&amp;gt;Pronto per il Hosting su GitHub Pages?&amp;lt;/h4&amp;gt;

        &amp;lt;!-- ================= PAGE 4: NPC &amp;amp; NAME GENERATOR ================= --&amp;gt;

                        &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Generatore di Nomi&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/h3&amp;gt;

                                &amp;lt;option value="human"&amp;gt;Umano&amp;lt;/option&amp;gt;
                                &amp;lt;option value="elf"&amp;gt;Elfo&amp;lt;/option&amp;gt;
                                &amp;lt;option value="dwarf"&amp;gt;Nano&amp;lt;/option&amp;gt;
                                &amp;lt;option value="orc"&amp;gt;Orco / Troll&amp;lt;/option&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;/select&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;div&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;label class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted block mb-1"&amp;gt;Genere&amp;lt;/label&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;select id="name-gender" class="w-full bg-fantasy-bg border border-fantasy-border rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-white text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-fantasy-gold"&amp;gt;
                                &amp;lt;option value="any"&amp;gt;Casuale / Neutro&amp;lt;/option&amp;gt;
                                &amp;lt;option value="male"&amp;gt;Maschile&amp;lt;/option&amp;gt;
                                &amp;lt;option value="female"&amp;gt;Femminile&amp;lt;/option&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;/select&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

                    &amp;lt;button onclick="generateNamesList()" class="w-full py-2 bg-fantasy-border hover:bg-fantasy-hover border border-fantasy-gold/30 text-fantasy-gold font-bold rounded-lg text-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center space-x-2"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-dice"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Genera 5 Nomi&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;

                    &amp;lt;div id="names-output-list" class="space-y-2 pt-2"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;div class="text-center text-fantasy-muted text-xs py-4"&amp;gt;Clicca il pulsante per generare i nomi.&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

                &amp;lt;!-- Complete Quick NPC Generator --&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div class="bg-fantasy-card border border-fantasy-border rounded-xl p-5 shadow-md space-y-4 flex flex-col justify-between"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;div&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;h3 class="font-cinzel text-base font-bold text-white border-b border-fantasy-border pb-2 flex items-center space-x-2"&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-id-card text-fantasy-gold text-xs"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Generatore NPG Rapido&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;/h3&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted my-3"&amp;gt;Crea un NPG completo di Nome, Ruolo, Tratto Caratteriale, Motivazione e Difetto.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;

                        &amp;lt;button onclick="generateFullNPC()" class="w-full py-2.5 bg-fantasy-crimson hover:bg-fantasy-crimsonLight text-white font-bold rounded-lg text-xs transition-all shadow-md flex items-center justify-center space-x-2"&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Genera Persona Completa&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;

                        &amp;lt;div id="npc-card-result" class="mt-4 p-4 bg-fantasy-bg rounded-xl border border-fantasy-border hidden space-y-3"&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;div class="border-b border-fantasy-border pb-2"&amp;gt;
                                &amp;lt;h4 id="npc-res-name" class="font-cinzel text-lg font-bold text-fantasy-gold"&amp;gt;Name&amp;lt;/h4&amp;gt;
                                &amp;lt;span id="npc-res-role" class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted font-semibold block"&amp;gt;Role&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;div class="text-xs space-y-1.5 text-fantasy-text"&amp;gt;
                                &amp;lt;p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;strong class="text-fantasy-gold"&amp;gt;Personalità:&amp;lt;/strong&amp;gt; &amp;lt;span id="npc-res-trait"&amp;gt;-&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;
                                &amp;lt;p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;strong class="text-fantasy-gold"&amp;gt;Obiettivo:&amp;lt;/strong&amp;gt; &amp;lt;span id="npc-res-motive"&amp;gt;-&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;
                                &amp;lt;p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;strong class="text-fantasy-gold"&amp;gt;Difetto / Segreto:&amp;lt;/strong&amp;gt; &amp;lt;span id="npc-res-flaw"&amp;gt;-&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

                    &amp;lt;div id="save-npc-btn-wrap" class="hidden pt-3 border-t border-fantasy-border"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;button onclick="copyNpcToClipboard()" class="w-full py-1.5 bg-fantasy-hover border border-fantasy-border text-fantasy-muted hover:text-white rounded-lg text-xs transition-colors flex items-center justify-center space-x-2"&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-copy"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Copia Scheda NPG&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
        &amp;lt;/section&amp;gt;


        &amp;lt;!-- ================= PAGE 5: DM SCRATCHPAD ================= --&amp;gt;
        &amp;lt;section id="view-notes" class="app-view space-y-6 hidden"&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-fantasy-border pb-4"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;h2 class="font-cinzel text-2xl font-bold text-white"&amp;gt;Scratchpad del Dungeon Master&amp;lt;/h2&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted"&amp;gt;Annota spunti di trama, nomi improvvisati o promemoria con salvataggio locale automatico&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;button onclick="createNewNote()" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-fantasy-crimson hover:bg-fantasy-crimsonLight text-white font-bold rounded-lg text-xs transition-all flex items-center space-x-1 shadow"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-plus"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Nuova Scheda&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

            &amp;lt;div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;!-- Sidebar Notes List --&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div class="bg-fantasy-card border border-fantasy-border rounded-xl p-4 shadow-md space-y-3"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;span class="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-fantasy-muted block border-b border-fantasy-border pb-2"&amp;gt;Note Salvate&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;div id="notes-sidebar-list" class="space-y-1 max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;button onclick="selectNote(1790437253911)" class="w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all truncate block bg-fantasy-crimson text-white shadow"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines mr-2"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;span&amp;gt;Appunti Prima Sessione&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

                &amp;lt;!-- Note Editor --&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div class="lg:col-span-3 bg-fantasy-card border border-fantasy-border rounded-xl p-5 shadow-md flex flex-col space-y-4"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-fantasy-border pb-3"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;input type="text" id="note-title-input" oninput="saveCurrentNote()" placeholder="Titolo della nota..." class="bg-transparent font-cinzel text-xl font-bold text-fantasy-gold focus:outline-none w-full"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;button onclick="deleteCurrentNote()" class="text-fantasy-muted hover:text-rose-400 text-xs px-2 py-1 transition-colors flex items-center space-x-1"&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                            &amp;lt;span class="hidden sm:inline"&amp;gt;Elimina&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

                    &amp;lt;textarea id="note-content-input" oninput="saveCurrentNote()" placeholder="Scrivi qui i tuoi appunti della sessione..." class="w-full flex-grow min-h-[320px] bg-fantasy-bg border border-fantasy-border rounded-xl p-4 text-sm text-fantasy-text focus:outline-none focus:border-fantasy-gold resize-y leading-relaxed font-sans"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/textarea&amp;gt;
                    
                    &amp;lt;div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] text-fantasy-muted"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span id="note-save-status"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-check text-emerald-400 mr-1"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;Salvato nel browser&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span id="note-char-count"&amp;gt;167 caratteri&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
        &amp;lt;/section&amp;gt;

    &amp;lt;/main&amp;gt;

    &amp;lt;!-- EXPORT FILE MODAL (FOR GITHUB PAGES MULTI-FILE ARCHITECTURE) --&amp;gt;
    &amp;lt;div id="export-modal" class="fixed inset-0 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4"&amp;gt;
        &amp;lt;div class="bg-fantasy-card border border-fantasy-gold/40 rounded-2xl max-w-2xl w-full p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl relative"&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;button onclick="closeExportModal()" class="absolute top-4 right-4 text-fantasy-muted hover:text-white"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-xmark text-lg"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;

            &amp;lt;div class="flex items-center space-x-3 border-b border-fantasy-border pb-3"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-fantasy-gold/20 border border-fantasy-gold/40 flex items-center justify-center text-fantasy-gold"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;i class="fa-brands fa-github text-xl"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/i&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;h3 class="font-cinzel text-lg font-bold text-white"&amp;gt;Esporta File per Repository GitHub&amp;lt;/h3&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted"&amp;gt;Puoi usare questa Single Page Application direttamente o separarla in sotto-pagine HTML fisiche.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

            &amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-text leading-relaxed"&amp;gt;
                GitHub Pages ti permette di ospitare sia questo singolo file come &amp;lt;code class="bg-fantasy-bg px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-fantasy-gold"&amp;gt;index.html&amp;lt;/code&amp;gt;, sia sotto-pagine dedicate. Seleziona il file da generare ed incolla il codice nel tuo repository:
            &amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;

            &amp;lt;div class="flex space-x-2 border-b border-fantasy-border pb-2 overflow-x-auto text-xs"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('index')" id="exp-tab-index" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-fantasy-muted"&amp;gt;index.html&amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('dice')" id="exp-tab-dice" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white bg-fantasy-hover text-fantasy-gold font-bold"&amp;gt;dice.html&amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('initiative')" id="exp-tab-initiative" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white text-fantasy-muted"&amp;gt;initiative.html&amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('names')" id="exp-tab-names" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white text-fantasy-muted"&amp;gt;names.html&amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('notes')" id="exp-tab-notes" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white text-fantasy-muted"&amp;gt;notes.html&amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

            &amp;lt;div class="relative"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;pre id="export-code-box" class="bg-fantasy-bg border border-fantasy-border rounded-xl p-4 text-[11px] font-mono text-fantasy-muted overflow-x-auto max-h-[220px] select-all"&amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;!-- dice.html per GitHub Pages --&amp;amp;gt;
&amp;amp;lt;html lang="it" class="dark h-full"&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;head&amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;lt;meta charset="UTF-8"&amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;lt;meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"&amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;lt;title&amp;amp;gt;Arcane Compendium - TTRPG Master Tools&amp;amp;lt;/title&amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;lt;script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;/script&amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;lt;script&amp;amp;gt;
        tailwind.config = {
            darkMode: 'class',
            theme: {
                extend: {
                    colors: {
                        fantasy: {
                            bg: '#0f0f13',
                            card: '#181820',
                            border: '#2a2a36',
                            hover: '#22222e',
                            crimson: '#9e1b2f',
                            crimsonLight: '#c8233d',
                            gold: '#d4af37',
                            goldLight: '#f3ca40',
                            text: '#e2e8f0',
                            muted: '#94a3b8'
                        }
                    },
                    fontFamily: {
                        cinzel: ['Georgia', 'serif'],
                        sans: ['Inter', 'system-ui', 'sans-serif']
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    &amp;amp;lt;/script&amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;lt;link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css"&amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;lt;style&amp;amp;gt;
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@600;700;900&amp;amp;amp;family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&amp;amp;amp;display=swap');
        
        .font-cinzel { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; }
        
        /* Custom scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #0f0f13;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #2a2a36;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #d4af37;
        }

        .gold-gradient-text {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f3ca40 0%, #d4af37 50%, #aa820a 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

        .crimson-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(158, 27, 47, 0.35);
        }

        .gold-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
        }

        @keyframes diceRoll {
            0% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(0.8); }
            50% { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(1.1); }
            100% { transform: rotate(360deg) scale(1); }
        }

        .animate-roll {
            animation: diceRoll 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
        }
    &amp;amp;lt;/style&amp;amp;gt;

                            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;lt;div class="text-xs space-y-1.5 text-fantasy-text"&amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;lt;p&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;strong class="text-fantasy-gold"&amp;amp;gt;Personalità:&amp;amp;lt;/strong&amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;lt;span id="npc-res-trait"&amp;amp;gt;-&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;/p&amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;lt;p&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;strong class="text-fantasy-gold"&amp;amp;gt;Obiettivo:&amp;amp;lt;/strong&amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;lt;span id="npc-res-motive"&amp;amp;gt;-&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;/p&amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;lt;p&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;strong class="text-fantasy-gold"&amp;amp;gt;Difetto / Segreto:&amp;amp;lt;/strong&amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;lt;span id="npc-res-flaw"&amp;amp;gt;-&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;/p&amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;

                    &amp;amp;lt;div id="save-npc-btn-wrap" class="hidden pt-3 border-t border-fantasy-border"&amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;lt;button onclick="copyNpcToClipboard()" class="w-full py-1.5 bg-fantasy-hover border border-fantasy-border text-fantasy-muted hover:text-white rounded-lg text-xs transition-colors flex items-center justify-center space-x-2"&amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-copy"&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;Copia Scheda NPG&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;
            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;
        &amp;amp;lt;/section&amp;amp;gt;


        &amp;amp;lt;!-- ================= PAGE 5: DM SCRATCHPAD ================= --&amp;amp;gt;
        &amp;amp;lt;section id="view-notes" class="app-view space-y-6 hidden"&amp;amp;gt;
            &amp;amp;lt;div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-fantasy-border pb-4"&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;div&amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;lt;h2 class="font-cinzel text-2xl font-bold text-white"&amp;amp;gt;Scratchpad del Dungeon Master&amp;amp;lt;/h2&amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;gt;Annota spunti di trama, nomi improvvisati o promemoria con salvataggio locale automatico&amp;amp;lt;/p&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;button onclick="createNewNote()" class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-fantasy-crimson hover:bg-fantasy-crimsonLight text-white font-bold rounded-lg text-xs transition-all flex items-center space-x-1 shadow"&amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-plus"&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;Nuova Scheda&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;
            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;

            &amp;amp;lt;div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6"&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;!-- Sidebar Notes List --&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;div class="bg-fantasy-card border border-fantasy-border rounded-xl p-4 shadow-md space-y-3"&amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;lt;span class="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-fantasy-muted block border-b border-fantasy-border pb-2"&amp;amp;gt;Note Salvate&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;lt;div id="notes-sidebar-list" class="space-y-1 max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto"&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;button onclick="selectNote(1790437253911)" class="w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all truncate block bg-fantasy-crimson text-white shadow"&amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines mr-2"&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;gt;Appunti Prima Sessione&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;
            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;

                &amp;amp;lt;!-- Note Editor --&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;div class="lg:col-span-3 bg-fantasy-card border border-fantasy-border rounded-xl p-5 shadow-md flex flex-col space-y-4"&amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;lt;div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b border-fantasy-border pb-3"&amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;lt;input type="text" id="note-title-input" oninput="saveCurrentNote()" placeholder="Titolo della nota..." class="bg-transparent font-cinzel text-xl font-bold text-fantasy-gold focus:outline-none w-full"&amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;lt;button onclick="deleteCurrentNote()" class="text-fantasy-muted hover:text-rose-400 text-xs px-2 py-1 transition-colors flex items-center space-x-1"&amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-trash-can"&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;lt;span class="hidden sm:inline"&amp;amp;gt;Elimina&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;

                    &amp;amp;lt;textarea id="note-content-input" oninput="saveCurrentNote()" placeholder="Scrivi qui i tuoi appunti della sessione..." class="w-full flex-grow min-h-[320px] bg-fantasy-bg border border-fantasy-border rounded-xl p-4 text-sm text-fantasy-text focus:outline-none focus:border-fantasy-gold resize-y leading-relaxed font-sans"&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;/textarea&amp;amp;gt;
                    
                    &amp;amp;lt;div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;lt;span id="note-save-status"&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-check text-emerald-400 mr-1"&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;gt;Salvato nel browser&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;lt;span id="note-char-count"&amp;amp;gt;167 caratteri&amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;
            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;
        &amp;amp;lt;/section&amp;amp;gt;

    &amp;amp;lt;/main&amp;amp;gt;

    &amp;amp;lt;!-- EXPORT FILE MODAL (FOR GITHUB PAGES MULTI-FILE ARCHITECTURE) --&amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;lt;div id="export-modal" class="fixed inset-0 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4"&amp;amp;gt;
        &amp;amp;lt;div class="bg-fantasy-card border border-fantasy-gold/40 rounded-2xl max-w-2xl w-full p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl relative"&amp;amp;gt;
            &amp;amp;lt;button onclick="closeExportModal()" class="absolute top-4 right-4 text-fantasy-muted hover:text-white"&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-xmark text-lg"&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;gt;
            &amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;

            &amp;amp;lt;div class="flex items-center space-x-3 border-b border-fantasy-border pb-3"&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-fantasy-gold/20 border border-fantasy-gold/40 flex items-center justify-center text-fantasy-gold"&amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-brands fa-github text-xl"&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;div&amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;lt;h3 class="font-cinzel text-lg font-bold text-white"&amp;amp;gt;Esporta File per Repository GitHub&amp;amp;lt;/h3&amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;gt;Puoi usare questa Single Page Application direttamente o separarla in sotto-pagine HTML fisiche.&amp;amp;lt;/p&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;
            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;

            &amp;amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-text leading-relaxed"&amp;amp;gt;
                GitHub Pages ti permette di ospitare sia questo singolo file come &amp;amp;lt;code class="bg-fantasy-bg px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-fantasy-gold"&amp;amp;gt;index.html&amp;amp;lt;/code&amp;amp;gt;, sia sotto-pagine dedicate. Seleziona il file da generare ed incolla il codice nel tuo repository:
            &amp;amp;lt;/p&amp;amp;gt;

            &amp;amp;lt;div class="flex space-x-2 border-b border-fantasy-border pb-2 overflow-x-auto text-xs"&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('index')" id="exp-tab-index" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;gt;index.html&amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('dice')" id="exp-tab-dice" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white bg-fantasy-hover text-fantasy-gold font-bold"&amp;amp;gt;dice.html&amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('initiative')" id="exp-tab-initiative" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;gt;initiative.html&amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('names')" id="exp-tab-names" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;gt;names.html&amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('notes')" id="exp-tab-notes" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;gt;notes.html&amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;gt;
            &amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;gt;

            &amp;amp;lt;div class="relative"&amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;lt;pre id="export-code-box" class="bg-fantasy-bg border border-fantasy-border rounded-xl p-4 text-[11px] font-mono text-fantasy-muted overflow-x-auto max-h-[220px] select-all"&amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;lt;!-- index.html per GitHub Pages --&amp;amp;amp;gt;
&amp;amp;amp;lt;html lang="it" class="dark h-full"&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;lt;head&amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;lt;meta charset="UTF-8"&amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;lt;meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"&amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;lt;title&amp;amp;amp;gt;Arcane Compendium - TTRPG Master Tools&amp;amp;amp;lt;/title&amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;lt;script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;lt;/script&amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;lt;script&amp;amp;amp;gt;
        tailwind.config = {
            darkMode: 'class',
            theme: {
                extend: {
                    colors: {
                        fantasy: {
                            bg: '#0f0f13',
                            card: '#181820',
                            border: '#2a2a36',
                            hover: '#22222e',
                            crimson: '#9e1b2f',
                            crimsonLight: '#c8233d',
                            gold: '#d4af37',
                            goldLight: '#f3ca40',
                            text: '#e2e8f0',
                            muted: '#94a3b8'
                        }
                    },
                    fontFamily: {
                        cinzel: ['Georgia', 'serif'],
                        sans: ['Inter', 'system-ui', 'sans-serif']
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    &amp;amp;amp;lt;/script&amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;lt;link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css"&amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;lt;style&amp;amp;amp;gt;
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@600;700;900&amp;amp;amp;amp;family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&amp;amp;amp;amp;display=swap');
        
        .font-cinzel { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; }
        
        /* Custom scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #0f0f13;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #2a2a36;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #d4af37;
        }

        .gold-gradient-text {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f3ca40 0%, #d4af37 50%, #aa820a 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

        .crimson-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(158, 27, 47, 0.35);
        }

        .gold-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
        }

        @keyframes diceRoll {
            0% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(0.8); }
            50% { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(1.1); }
            100% { transform: rotate(360deg) scale(1); }
        }

        .animate-roll {
            animation: diceRoll 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
        }
    &amp;amp;amp;lt;/style&amp;amp;amp;gt;

                    &amp;amp;amp;lt;div&amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;lt;h3 class="font-cinzel text-base font-bold text-white border-b border-fantasy-border pb-2 flex items-center space-x-2"&amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-id-card text-fantasy-gold text-xs"&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;amp;gt;

                        &amp;amp;amp;lt;/h3&amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted my-3"&amp;amp;amp;gt;Crea un NPG completo di Nome, Ruolo, Tratto Caratteriale, Motivazione e Difetto.&amp;amp;amp;lt;/p&amp;amp;amp;gt;

                        &amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="generateFullNPC()" class="w-full py-2.5 bg-fantasy-crimson hover:bg-fantasy-crimsonLight text-white font-bold rounded-lg text-xs transition-all shadow-md flex items-center justify-center space-x-2"&amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-wand-magic-sparkles"&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;amp;gt;Genera Persona Completa&amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;gt;

                        &amp;amp;amp;lt;div id="npc-card-result" class="mt-4 p-4 bg-fantasy-bg rounded-xl border border-fantasy-border hidden space-y-3"&amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="border-b border-fantasy-border pb-2"&amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;lt;h4 id="npc-res-name" class="font-cinzel text-lg font-bold text-fantasy-gold"&amp;amp;amp;gt;Name&amp;amp;amp;lt;/h4&amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;lt;span id="npc-res-role" class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted font-semibold block"&amp;amp;amp;gt;Role&amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;gt;

                                &amp;amp;amp;lt;p&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;lt;strong class="text-fantasy-gold"&amp;amp;amp;gt;Obiettivo:&amp;amp;amp;lt;/strong&amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;lt;span id="npc-res-motive"&amp;amp;amp;gt;-&amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;lt;/p&amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;lt;p&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;lt;strong class="text-fantasy-gold"&amp;amp;amp;gt;Difetto / Segreto:&amp;amp;amp;lt;/strong&amp;amp;amp;gt; &amp;amp;amp;lt;span id="npc-res-flaw"&amp;amp;amp;gt;-&amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;lt;/p&amp;amp;amp;gt;

                        &amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;gt;

                    &amp;amp;amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;gt;Annota spunti di trama, nomi improvvisati o promemoria con salvataggio locale automatico&amp;amp;amp;lt;/p&amp;amp;amp;gt;

                &amp;amp;amp;lt;div&amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;lt;h3 class="font-cinzel text-lg font-bold text-white"&amp;amp;amp;gt;Esporta File per Repository GitHub&amp;amp;amp;lt;/h3&amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;gt;Puoi usare questa Single Page Application direttamente o separarla in sotto-pagine HTML fisiche.&amp;amp;amp;lt;/p&amp;amp;amp;gt;

            &amp;amp;amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-text leading-relaxed"&amp;amp;amp;gt;
                GitHub Pages ti permette di ospitare sia questo singolo file come &amp;amp;amp;lt;code class="bg-fantasy-bg px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-fantasy-gold"&amp;amp;amp;gt;index.html&amp;amp;amp;lt;/code&amp;amp;amp;gt;, sia sotto-pagine dedicate. Seleziona il file da generare ed incolla il codice nel tuo repository:
            &amp;amp;amp;lt;/p&amp;amp;amp;gt;

            &amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="flex space-x-2 border-b border-fantasy-border pb-2 overflow-x-auto text-xs"&amp;amp;amp;gt;

                &amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('dice')" id="exp-tab-dice" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;gt;dice.html&amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('initiative')" id="exp-tab-initiative" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;gt;initiative.html&amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('names')" id="exp-tab-names" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;gt;names.html&amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('notes')" id="exp-tab-notes" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;gt;notes.html&amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;gt;

            &amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="relative"&amp;amp;amp;gt;

&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;html lang="it" class="dark h-full"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;head&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

    &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;script&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
        tailwind.config = {
            darkMode: 'class',
            theme: {
                extend: {
                    colors: {
                        fantasy: {
                            bg: '#0f0f13',
                            card: '#181820',
                            border: '#2a2a36',
                            hover: '#22222e',
                            crimson: '#9e1b2f',
                            crimsonLight: '#c8233d',
                            gold: '#d4af37',
                            goldLight: '#f3ca40',
                            text: '#e2e8f0',
                            muted: '#94a3b8'
                        }
                    },
                    fontFamily: {
                        cinzel: ['Georgia', 'serif'],
                        sans: ['Inter', 'system-ui', 'sans-serif']

    &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;style&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@600;700;900&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;display=swap');
        
        .font-cinzel { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; }
        
        /* Custom scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #0f0f13;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #2a2a36;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #d4af37;
        }

        .gold-gradient-text {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f3ca40 0%, #d4af37 50%, #aa820a 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

        .crimson-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(158, 27, 47, 0.35);
        }

        .gold-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
        }

        @keyframes diceRoll {
            0% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(0.8); }
            50% { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(1.1); }
            100% { transform: rotate(360deg) scale(1); }
        }

        .animate-roll {
            animation: diceRoll 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
        }

                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span id="note-save-status"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-check text-emerald-400 mr-1"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;Salvato nel browser&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span id="note-char-count"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;167 caratteri&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

    &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/main&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

    &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;!-- EXPORT FILE MODAL (FOR GITHUB PAGES MULTI-FILE ARCHITECTURE) --&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div id="export-modal" class="fixed inset-0 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
        &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="bg-fantasy-card border border-fantasy-gold/40 rounded-2xl max-w-2xl w-full p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl relative"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="closeExportModal()" class="absolute top-4 right-4 text-fantasy-muted hover:text-white"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-xmark text-lg"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

            &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="flex items-center space-x-3 border-b border-fantasy-border pb-3"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-fantasy-gold/20 border border-fantasy-gold/40 flex items-center justify-center text-fantasy-gold"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-brands fa-github text-xl"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;h3 class="font-cinzel text-lg font-bold text-white"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;Esporta File per Repository GitHub&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/h3&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;Puoi usare questa Single Page Application direttamente o separarla in sotto-pagine HTML fisiche.&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/p&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

            &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-text leading-relaxed"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                GitHub Pages ti permette di ospitare sia questo singolo file come &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;code class="bg-fantasy-bg px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-fantasy-gold"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;index.html&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/code&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;, sia sotto-pagine dedicate. Seleziona il file da generare ed incolla il codice nel tuo repository:
            &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/p&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

            &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="flex space-x-2 border-b border-fantasy-border pb-2 overflow-x-auto text-xs"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('index')" id="exp-tab-index" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-fantasy-hover text-fantasy-gold font-bold"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;index.html&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('dice')" id="exp-tab-dice" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;dice.html&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('initiative')" id="exp-tab-initiative" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;initiative.html&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('names')" id="exp-tab-names" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;names.html&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('notes')" id="exp-tab-notes" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;notes.html&amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

            &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="relative"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;pre id="export-code-box" class="bg-fantasy-bg border border-fantasy-border rounded-xl p-4 text-[11px] font-mono text-fantasy-muted overflow-x-auto max-h-[220px] select-all"&amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;!-- index.html per GitHub Pages --&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;html lang="it" class="dark h-full"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;head&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;meta charset="UTF-8"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;title&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;Arcane Compendium - TTRPG Master Tools&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/title&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/script&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;script&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
        tailwind.config = {
            darkMode: 'class',
            theme: {
                extend: {
                    colors: {
                        fantasy: {
                            bg: '#0f0f13',
                            card: '#181820',
                            border: '#2a2a36',
                            hover: '#22222e',
                            crimson: '#9e1b2f',
                            crimsonLight: '#c8233d',
                            gold: '#d4af37',
                            goldLight: '#f3ca40',
                            text: '#e2e8f0',
                            muted: '#94a3b8'
                        }
                    },
                    fontFamily: {
                        cinzel: ['Georgia', 'serif'],
                        sans: ['Inter', 'system-ui', 'sans-serif']
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/script&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;style&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@600;700;900&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;display=swap');
        
        .font-cinzel { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; }
        
        /* Custom scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #0f0f13;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #2a2a36;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #d4af37;
        }

        .gold-gradient-text {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f3ca40 0%, #d4af37 50%, #aa820a 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

        .crimson-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(158, 27, 47, 0.35);
        }

        .gold-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
        }

        @keyframes diceRoll {
            0% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(0.8); }
            50% { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(1.1); }
            100% { transform: rotate(360deg) scale(1); }
        }

        .animate-roll {
            animation: diceRoll 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
        }
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/style&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-fantasy-gold/20 border border-fantasy-gold/40 flex items-center justify-center text-fantasy-gold"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-brands fa-github text-xl"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;h3 class="font-cinzel text-lg font-bold text-white"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;Esporta File per Repository GitHub&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/h3&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;Puoi usare questa Single Page Application direttamente o separarla in sotto-pagine HTML fisiche.&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/p&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;p class="text-xs text-fantasy-text leading-relaxed"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                GitHub Pages ti permette di ospitare sia questo singolo file come &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;code class="bg-fantasy-bg px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-fantasy-gold"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;index.html&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/code&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;, sia sotto-pagine dedicate. Seleziona il file da generare ed incolla il codice nel tuo repository:
            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/p&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="flex space-x-2 border-b border-fantasy-border pb-2 overflow-x-auto text-xs"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('index')" id="exp-tab-index" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-fantasy-hover text-fantasy-gold font-bold"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;index.html&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('names')" id="exp-tab-names" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;names.html&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="switchExportTab('notes')" id="exp-tab-notes" class="exp-tab px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:text-white text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;notes.html&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;html lang="it" class="dark h-full"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;head&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;title&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;Arcane Compendium - TTRPG Master Tools&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/title&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/script&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;script&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
        tailwind.config = {
            darkMode: 'class',
            theme: {
                extend: {
                    colors: {
                        fantasy: {
                            bg: '#0f0f13',
                            card: '#181820',
                            border: '#2a2a36',
                            hover: '#22222e',
                            crimson: '#9e1b2f',
                            crimsonLight: '#c8233d',
                            gold: '#d4af37',
                            goldLight: '#f3ca40',
                            text: '#e2e8f0',
                            muted: '#94a3b8'
                        }
                    },
                    fontFamily: {
                        cinzel: ['Georgia', 'serif'],
                        sans: ['Inter', 'system-ui', 'sans-serif']
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        .font-cinzel { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; }
        
        /* Custom scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #0f0f13;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #2a2a36;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #d4af37;
        }

        .gold-gradient-text {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f3ca40 0%, #d4af37 50%, #aa820a 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

        .crimson-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(158, 27, 47, 0.35);
        }

        .gold-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
        }

        @keyframes diceRoll {
            0% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(0.8); }
            50% { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(1.1); }
            100% { transform: rotate(360deg) scale(1); }
        }

        .animate-roll {
            animation: diceRoll 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
        }
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/style&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-brands fa-github text-xl"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;html lang="it" class="dark h-full"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;head&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;title&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;Arcane Compendium - TTRPG Master Tools&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/title&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/script&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

        tailwind.config = {
            darkMode: 'class',
            theme: {
                extend: {

        .font-cinzel { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; }
        
        /* Custom scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #0f0f13;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #2a2a36;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #d4af37;
        }

        .gold-gradient-text {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f3ca40 0%, #d4af37 50%, #aa820a 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

        .crimson-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(158, 27, 47, 0.35);
        }

        .gold-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
        }

        @keyframes diceRoll {
            0% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(0.8); }
            50% { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(1.1); }
            100% { transform: rotate(360deg) scale(1); }
        }

        .animate-roll {
            animation: diceRoll 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
        }

        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {

            border-radius: 3px;

            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

        }

        .gold-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
        }

        @keyframes diceRoll {
            0% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(0.8); }
            50% { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(1.1); }
            100% { transform: rotate(360deg) scale(1); }
        }

        .animate-roll {
            animation: diceRoll 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
        }

            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: #0f0f13;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: #2a2a36;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
            background: #d4af37;
        }

        .gold-gradient-text {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f3ca40 0%, #d4af37 50%, #aa820a 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

        .crimson-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(158, 27, 47, 0.35);
        }

        .gold-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
        }

        @keyframes diceRoll {
            0% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(0.8); }
            50% { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(1.1); }
            100% { transform: rotate(360deg) scale(1); }
        }

        .animate-roll {
            animation: diceRoll 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
        }

            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(158, 27, 47, 0.35);
        }

        .gold-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
        }

        @keyframes diceRoll {
            0% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(0.8); }
            50% { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(1.1); }
            100% { transform: rotate(360deg) scale(1); }
        }

        .animate-roll {
            animation: diceRoll 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
        }

            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

        }

        .gold-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
        }

        @keyframes diceRoll {
            0% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(0.8); }
            50% { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(1.1); }
            100% { transform: rotate(360deg) scale(1); }
        }

        .animate-roll {
            animation: diceRoll 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
        }

        }

            background: #2a2a36;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

            background: #d4af37;
        }

            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f3ca40 0%, #d4af37 50%, #aa820a 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }

            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(158, 27, 47, 0.35);
        }

        .gold-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.25);
        }

        @keyframes diceRoll {
            0% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(0.8); }
            50% { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(1.1); }
            100% { transform: rotate(360deg) scale(1); }
        }

        .animate-roll {
            animation: diceRoll 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
        }
