        /* ================= ROUTING &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; SPA NAVIGATION ================= */
        const views = ['home', 'dice', 'initiative', 'names', 'notes'];

        function navigateTo(route) {
            const cleanRoute = route.replace('#', '') || 'home';
            
            // Hide all views
            views.forEach(v =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; {
                const el = document.getElementById(`view-${v}`);
                if (el) el.classList.add('hidden');
            });

            // Show selected view
            const targetView = document.getElementById(`view-${cleanRoute}`) ? cleanRoute : 'home';
            document.getElementById(`view-${targetView}`).classList.remove('hidden');

            // Update desktop active nav
            document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(btn =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; {
                btn.classList.remove('bg-fantasy-crimson', 'text-white', 'shadow');
                btn.classList.add('text-fantasy-muted', 'hover:text-white', 'hover:bg-fantasy-hover');
            });

            const activeNav = document.getElementById(`nav-${targetView}`);
            if (activeNav) {
                activeNav.classList.remove('text-fantasy-muted', 'hover:text-white', 'hover:bg-fantasy-hover');
                activeNav.classList.add('bg-fantasy-crimson', 'text-white', 'shadow');
            }

            // Close mobile menu if open
            document.getElementById('mobile-menu').classList.add('hidden');
            
            // Update window hash
            window.location.hash = targetView === 'home' ? '' : targetView;
        }

        function toggleMobileMenu() {
            const menu = document.getElementById('mobile-menu');
            menu.classList.toggle('hidden');
        }

        window.addEventListener('hashchange', () =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; {
            navigateTo(window.location.hash);
        });


        /* ================= 1. DICE ROLLER UTILITY ================= */
        let diceHistory = [];

        function rollDiceValue(sides) {
            return Math.floor(Math.random() * sides) + 1;
        }

        function rollQuickDice(sides) {
            const result = rollDiceValue(sides);
            displayDiceResult(result, `Lancio singolo 1d${sides}`);
            addDiceHistory(`1d${sides}`, result, [result]);
        }

        function rollCustomDice(mode = 'normal') {
            const count = parseInt(document.getElementById('dice-count').value) || 1;
            const sides = parseInt(document.getElementById('dice-type').value) || 20;
            const mod = parseInt(document.getElementById('dice-modifier').value) || 0;

            let rolls = [];
            let total = 0;
            let detailsStr = '';

            if (mode === 'advantage' &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; sides === 20) {
                const r1 = rollDiceValue(20);
                const r2 = rollDiceValue(20);
                const chosen = Math.max(r1, r2);
                total = chosen + mod;
                rolls = [r1, r2];
                detailsStr = `2d20 con Vantaggio (${r1}, ${r2}) ${mod &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;= 0 ? '+' : ''}${mod}`;
            } else if (mode === 'disadvantage' &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; sides === 20) {
                const r1 = rollDiceValue(20);
                const r2 = rollDiceValue(20);
                const chosen = Math.min(r1, r2);
                total = chosen + mod;
                rolls = [r1, r2];
                detailsStr = `2d20 con Svantaggio (${r1}, ${r2}) ${mod &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;= 0 ? '+' : ''}${mod}`;
            } else {
                for (let i = 0; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; count; i++) {
                    const r = rollDiceValue(sides);
                    rolls.push(r);
                    total += r;
                }
                total += mod;
                detailsStr = `${count}d${sides} (${rolls.join(', ')}) ${mod &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;= 0 ? '+' : ''}${mod}`;
            }

            displayDiceResult(total, detailsStr);
            addDiceHistory(`${count}d${sides}${mod !== 0 ? (mod &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; 0 ? '+'+mod : mod) : ''}`, total, rolls);
        }

        function displayDiceResult(val, details) {
            const valEl = document.getElementById('dice-result-val');
            const detEl = document.getElementById('dice-result-details');
            
            valEl.innerText = val;
            detEl.innerText = details;

            valEl.classList.remove('animate-roll');
            void valEl.offsetWidth; // trigger reflow
            valEl.classList.add('animate-roll');
        }

        function addDiceHistory(label, result, rolls) {
            diceHistory.unshift({ label, result, rolls, time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour: '2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}) });
            if (diceHistory.length &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; 25) diceHistory.pop();
            renderDiceHistory();
        }

        function renderDiceHistory() {
            const listEl = document.getElementById('dice-history-list');
            if (diceHistory.length === 0) {
                listEl.innerHTML = `&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="text-center text-fantasy-muted text-xs py-8"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;Nessun tiro effettuato.&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;`;
                return;
            }

            listEl.innerHTML = diceHistory.map(item =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; `
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="bg-fantasy-bg border border-fantasy-border p-3 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between text-xs"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span class="font-bold text-fantasy-gold block"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;${item.label}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span class="text-[10px] text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;${item.time}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="font-cinzel text-lg font-bold text-white"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        ${item.result}
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            `).join('');
        }

        function clearDiceHistory() {
            diceHistory = [];
            renderDiceHistory();
        }


        /* ================= 2. INITIATIVE TRACKER ================= */
        let combatants = [];
        let currentTurnIndex = -1;
        let combatRound = 1;

        function handleAddCombatant(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const name = document.getElementById('comb-name').value;
            const init = parseInt(document.getElementById('comb-init').value) || 0;
            const hp = parseInt(document.getElementById('comb-hp').value) || 10;
            const type = document.getElementById('comb-type').value;

            combatants.push({
                id: Date.now(),
                name,
                init,
                hp,
                maxHp: hp,
                type
            });

            document.getElementById('comb-name').value = '';
            sortInitiative();
        }

        function sortInitiative() {
            combatants.sort((a, b) =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; b.init - a.init);
            if (currentTurnIndex === -1 &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; combatants.length &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; 0) {
                currentTurnIndex = 0;
            }
            renderCombatants();
        }

        function nextTurn() {
            if (combatants.length === 0) return;
            currentTurnIndex++;
            if (currentTurnIndex &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;= combatants.length) {
                currentTurnIndex = 0;
                combatRound++;
            }
            renderCombatants();
        }

        function changeHp(id, delta) {
            const c = combatants.find(item =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; item.id === id);
            if (c) {
                c.hp = Math.max(0, c.hp + delta);
                renderCombatants();
            }
        }

        function removeCombatant(id) {
            combatants = combatants.filter(item =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; item.id !== id);
            if (currentTurnIndex &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;= combatants.length) {
                currentTurnIndex = Math.max(0, combatants.length - 1);
            }
            renderCombatants();
        }

        function resetCombat() {
            combatants = [];
            currentTurnIndex = -1;
            combatRound = 1;
            renderCombatants();
        }

        function renderCombatants() {
            document.getElementById('combat-round').innerText = combatRound;
            document.getElementById('combat-count').innerText = combatants.length;

            const activeNameEl = document.getElementById('current-turn-name');
            if (combatants.length &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; 0 &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; currentTurnIndex &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;= 0) {
                activeNameEl.innerText = combatants[currentTurnIndex].name;
            } else {
                activeNameEl.innerText = 'Nessuno';
            }

            const listEl = document.getElementById('combatants-list');
            if (combatants.length === 0) {
                listEl.innerHTML = `&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="text-center text-fantasy-muted text-xs py-10"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;Nessun partecipante in combattimento.&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;`;
                return;
            }

            listEl.innerHTML = combatants.map((c, idx) =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; {
                const isActive = idx === currentTurnIndex;
                const hpPercent = Math.round((c.hp / c.maxHp) * 100);
                
                let badgeColor = 'bg-blue-950 text-blue-300 border-blue-800';
                if (c.type === 'enemy') badgeColor = 'bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border-rose-800';
                if (c.type === 'ally') badgeColor = 'bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-800';

                return `
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="p-3 rounded-xl border transition-all ${isActive ? 'bg-fantasy-hover border-fantasy-gold shadow-lg ring-1 ring-fantasy-gold/50' : 'bg-fantasy-bg border-fantasy-border'} flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="flex items-center space-x-3 w-full sm:w-auto"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-fantasy-border font-cinzel text-fantasy-gold font-bold flex items-center justify-center text-sm"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                ${c.init}
                            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="flex items-center space-x-2"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span class="font-bold text-white text-sm"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;${c.name}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span class="text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded border ${badgeColor} font-semibold uppercase"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;${c.type}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="w-32 bg-fantasy-border h-1.5 rounded-full mt-1.5 overflow-hidden"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="bg-fantasy-crimson h-full transition-all" style="width: ${hpPercent}%"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

                        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="flex items-center justify-between sm:justify-end w-full sm:w-auto space-x-3"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="flex items-center space-x-1"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="changeHp(${c.id}, -5)" class="w-6 h-6 bg-fantasy-border hover:bg-fantasy-crimson rounded text-white text-xs"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;-5&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="changeHp(${c.id}, -1)" class="w-6 h-6 bg-fantasy-border hover:bg-fantasy-crimson rounded text-white text-xs"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;-1&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span class="text-xs font-bold w-12 text-center text-white"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;${c.hp}/${c.maxHp}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="changeHp(${c.id}, 1)" class="w-6 h-6 bg-fantasy-border hover:bg-emerald-800 rounded text-white text-xs"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;+1&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="changeHp(${c.id}, 5)" class="w-6 h-6 bg-fantasy-border hover:bg-emerald-800 rounded text-white text-xs"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;+5&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="removeCombatant(${c.id})" class="text-fantasy-muted hover:text-rose-400 text-xs p-1"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-trash"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                `;
            }).join('');
        }


        /* ================= 3. NPC &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; NAME GENERATOR ================= */
        const nameData = {
            human: {
                male: ["Alistair", "Bram", "Cedric", "Gareth", "Julian", "Lucan", "Roderick", "Tristan"],
                female: ["Adelaide", "Beatrix", "Clara", "Evelyn", "Genevieve", "Isolda", "Mireia", "Rosalind"],
                surname: ["Blackwood", "Ironhart", "Vane", "Sterling", "Crowley", "Oakhaven", "Winter"]
            },
            elf: {
                male: ["Aerendil", "Caelynn", "Faelar", "Galanodel", "Ilonis", "Lorian", "Saelorn", "Thalor"],
                female: ["Aria", "Caeda", "Elysia", "Lethien", "Lyra", "Naerwen", "Saria", "Valerius"],
                surname: ["Moonwhisper", "Starweaver", "Sunshadow", "Windrunner", "Silversong"]
            },
            dwarf: {
                male: ["Balthor", "Durnim", "Eldrin", "Gimrak", "Kargrim", "Thorin", "Thrumkell", "Varok"],
                female: ["Bardryn", "Dagnal", "Helja", "Kilia", "Liftrasa", "Torbera", "Vondra"],
                surname: ["Bronzebeard", "Ironfist", "Stoneforge", "Deepdelver", "Goldhammer"]
            },
            orc: {
                male: ["Gharak", "Grommash", "Kaghur", "Mokthar", "Rukhar", "Tark", "Ugrosh", "Zuljin"],
                female: ["Brakka", "Gharsha", "Kasha", "Mogrash", "Oruka", "Shautha", "Usha"],
                surname: ["Bloodjaw", "Skullcrusher", "Ironhide", "Bonebreaker", "Doomhammer"]
            }
        };

        const npcRoles = ["Mercante Ambiguo", "Guardia della Citta", "Nobile Decaduto", "Spia di Fazione", "Accademico dell'Arcano", "Locandiere Chiacchierone", "Mercenario in Congedo"];
        const npcTraits = ["Estremamente cauto e diffidente", "Maniacalmente formale ed educato", "Parla a bassa voce guardandosi sempre attorno", "Incredibilmente allegro nonostante i pericoli", "Sempre distratto e con la testa tra le nuvole"];
        const npcMotives = ["Pagare un vecchio debito di gioco", "Rintracciare un parente scomparso", "Accumulare ricchezze per comprare un titolo", "Proteggere un antico segreto di famiglia", "Ottenere vendetta su un rivale locale"];
        const npcFlaws = ["Non riesce a mantenere un segreto se corrotto con dell'ottimo vino", "Troppo orgoglioso per ammettere di aver sbagliato", "Nasconde una maledizione latente", "Ha il terrore viscerale dei luoghi chiusi"];

        function getRandomItem(arr) {
            return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];
        }

        function generateNamesList() {
            const race = document.getElementById('name-race').value;
            const genderSelect = document.getElementById('name-gender').value;
            const data = nameData[race];

            let names = [];
            for (let i = 0; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; 5; i++) {
                let gender = genderSelect;
                if (gender === 'any') gender = Math.random() &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; 0.5 ? 'male' : 'female';
                const first = getRandomItem(data[gender]);
                const last = getRandomItem(data.surname);
                names.push(`${first} ${last}`);
            }

            const listEl = document.getElementById('names-output-list');
            listEl.innerHTML = names.map(n =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; `
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="p-2 bg-fantasy-bg border border-fantasy-border rounded-lg text-sm text-fantasy-text flex items-center justify-between"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;${n}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="navigator.clipboard.writeText('${n}')" class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted hover:text-fantasy-gold p-1"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-copy"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            `).join('');
        }

        let currentNPC = null;

        function generateFullNPC() {
            const races = ['human', 'elf', 'dwarf', 'orc'];
            const race = getRandomItem(races);
            const gender = Math.random() &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; 0.5 ? 'male' : 'female';
            const first = getRandomItem(nameData[race][gender]);
            const last = getRandomItem(nameData[race].surname);
            
            currentNPC = {
                name: `${first} ${last}`,
                role: `${getRandomItem(npcRoles)} (${race.toUpperCase()})`,
                trait: getRandomItem(npcTraits),
                motive: getRandomItem(npcMotives),
                flaw: getRandomItem(npcFlaws)
            };

            document.getElementById('npc-res-name').innerText = currentNPC.name;
            document.getElementById('npc-res-role').innerText = currentNPC.role;
            document.getElementById('npc-res-trait').innerText = currentNPC.trait;
            document.getElementById('npc-res-motive').innerText = currentNPC.motive;
            document.getElementById('npc-res-flaw').innerText = currentNPC.flaw;

            document.getElementById('npc-card-result').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('save-npc-btn-wrap').classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        function copyNpcToClipboard() {
            if (!currentNPC) return;
            const text = `NPG: ${currentNPC.name}\nRuolo: ${currentNPC.role}\nPersonalità: ${currentNPC.trait}\nObiettivo: ${currentNPC.motive}\nDifetto/Segreto: ${currentNPC.flaw}`;
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
            alert("Scheda NPG copiata negli appunti!");
        }


        /* ================= 4. DM SCRATCHPAD (LOCAL STORAGE) ================= */
        let notes = [];
        let activeNoteId = null;

        function loadNotes() {
            const saved = localStorage.getItem('ttrpg_dm_notes');
            if (saved) {
                try {
                    notes = JSON.parse(saved);
                } catch(e) {
                    notes = [];
                }
            }

            if (notes.length === 0) {
                notes = [{
                    id: Date.now(),
                    title: "Appunti Prima Sessione",
                    content: "Benvenuto nel tuo Scratchpad DM!\n\n- Qui puoi annotare nomi di Taverne, spunti di trama improvvisati o promemoria.\n- Le note si salvano automaticamente nel tuo browser."
                }];
                saveNotesToStorage();
            }

            activeNoteId = notes[0].id;
            renderNotesSidebar();
            loadActiveNoteIntoEditor();
        }

        function saveNotesToStorage() {
            localStorage.setItem('ttrpg_dm_notes', JSON.stringify(notes));
        }

        function renderNotesSidebar() {
            const sidebar = document.getElementById('notes-sidebar-list');
            sidebar.innerHTML = notes.map(n =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; `
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="selectNote(${n.id})" class="w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all truncate block ${n.id === activeNoteId ? 'bg-fantasy-crimson text-white shadow' : 'text-fantasy-muted hover:bg-fantasy-hover hover:text-white'}"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines mr-2"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;${n.title || 'Senza Titolo'}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            `).join('');
        }

        function selectNote(id) {
            activeNoteId = id;
            renderNotesSidebar();
            loadActiveNoteIntoEditor();
        }

        function loadActiveNoteIntoEditor() {
            const note = notes.find(n =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; n.id === activeNoteId);
            if (!note) return;

            document.getElementById('note-title-input').value = note.title;
            document.getElementById('note-content-input').value = note.content;
            updateCharCount();
        }

        function saveCurrentNote() {
            const note = notes.find(n =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; n.id === activeNoteId);
            if (!note) return;

            note.title = document.getElementById('note-title-input').value;
            note.content = document.getElementById('note-content-input').value;

            saveNotesToStorage();
            renderNotesSidebar();
            updateCharCount();
        }

        function createNewNote() {
            const newNote = {
                id: Date.now(),
                title: "Nuova Nota",
                content: ""
            };
            notes.unshift(newNote);
            activeNoteId = newNote.id;
            saveNotesToStorage();
            renderNotesSidebar();
            loadActiveNoteIntoEditor();
        }

        function deleteCurrentNote() {
            if (notes.length &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;= 1) {
                alert("Devi mantenere almeno una nota!");
                return;
            }
            notes = notes.filter(n =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; n.id !== activeNoteId);
            activeNoteId = notes[0].id;
            saveNotesToStorage();
            renderNotesSidebar();
            loadActiveNoteIntoEditor();
        }

        function updateCharCount() {
            const content = document.getElementById('note-content-input').value;
            document.getElementById('note-char-count').innerText = `${content.length} caratteri`;
        }


        /* ================= GITHUB PAGES MULTI-FILE EXPORTER ================= */
        function openExportModal() {
            document.getElementById('export-modal').classList.remove('hidden');
            switchExportTab('index');
        }

        function closeExportModal() {
            document.getElementById('export-modal').classList.add('hidden');
        }

        function switchExportTab(fileName) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.exp-tab').forEach(t =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; {
                t.classList.remove('bg-fantasy-hover', 'text-fantasy-gold', 'font-bold');
                t.classList.add('text-fantasy-muted');
            });
            const activeTab = document.getElementById(`exp-tab-${fileName}`);
            if (activeTab) {
                activeTab.classList.add('bg-fantasy-hover', 'text-fantasy-gold', 'font-bold');
                activeTab.classList.remove('text-fantasy-muted');
            }

            const codeBox = document.getElementById('export-code-box');
            codeBox.textContent = `&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;!-- ${fileName}.html per GitHub Pages --&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;\n` + document.documentElement.outerHTML;
        }

        function copyExportCode() {
            const code = document.getElementById('export-code-box').textContent;
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
            alert("Codice HTML copiato negli appunti!");
        }


        /* ================= INITIALIZATION ================= */

            // Check hash on startup
            if (window.location.hash) {
                navigateTo(window.location.hash);
            } else {
                navigateTo('home');
            }
            loadNotes();
        }
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/script&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/body&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/html&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/pre&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="flex justify-end space-x-3 pt-2"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="copyExportCode()" class="px-4 py-2 bg-fantasy-gold text-fantasy-bg font-bold rounded-lg text-xs hover:bg-fantasy-goldLight transition-all flex items-center space-x-2"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-copy"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;Copia Codice File&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;


    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;script&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
        /* ================= ROUTING &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; SPA NAVIGATION ================= */
        const views = ['home', 'dice', 'initiative', 'names', 'notes'];

        function navigateTo(route) {
            const cleanRoute = route.replace('#', '') || 'home';
            
            // Hide all views
            views.forEach(v =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; {
                const el = document.getElementById(`view-${v}`);
                if (el) el.classList.add('hidden');
            });

            // Show selected view
            const targetView = document.getElementById(`view-${cleanRoute}`) ? cleanRoute : 'home';
            document.getElementById(`view-${targetView}`).classList.remove('hidden');

            // Update desktop active nav
            document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(btn =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; {
                btn.classList.remove('bg-fantasy-crimson', 'text-white', 'shadow');
                btn.classList.add('text-fantasy-muted', 'hover:text-white', 'hover:bg-fantasy-hover');
            });

            const activeNav = document.getElementById(`nav-${targetView}`);
            if (activeNav) {
                activeNav.classList.remove('text-fantasy-muted', 'hover:text-white', 'hover:bg-fantasy-hover');
                activeNav.classList.add('bg-fantasy-crimson', 'text-white', 'shadow');
            }

            // Close mobile menu if open
            document.getElementById('mobile-menu').classList.add('hidden');
            
            // Update window hash
            window.location.hash = targetView === 'home' ? '' : targetView;
        }

        function toggleMobileMenu() {
            const menu = document.getElementById('mobile-menu');
            menu.classList.toggle('hidden');
        }

        window.addEventListener('hashchange', () =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; {
            navigateTo(window.location.hash);
        });


        /* ================= 1. DICE ROLLER UTILITY ================= */
        let diceHistory = [];

        function rollDiceValue(sides) {
            return Math.floor(Math.random() * sides) + 1;
        }

        function rollQuickDice(sides) {
            const result = rollDiceValue(sides);
            displayDiceResult(result, `Lancio singolo 1d${sides}`);
            addDiceHistory(`1d${sides}`, result, [result]);
        }

        function rollCustomDice(mode = 'normal') {
            const count = parseInt(document.getElementById('dice-count').value) || 1;
            const sides = parseInt(document.getElementById('dice-type').value) || 20;
            const mod = parseInt(document.getElementById('dice-modifier').value) || 0;

            let rolls = [];
            let total = 0;
            let detailsStr = '';

            if (mode === 'advantage' &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; sides === 20) {
                const r1 = rollDiceValue(20);
                const r2 = rollDiceValue(20);
                const chosen = Math.max(r1, r2);
                total = chosen + mod;
                rolls = [r1, r2];
                detailsStr = `2d20 con Vantaggio (${r1}, ${r2}) ${mod &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;= 0 ? '+' : ''}${mod}`;
            } else if (mode === 'disadvantage' &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; sides === 20) {
                const r1 = rollDiceValue(20);
                const r2 = rollDiceValue(20);
                const chosen = Math.min(r1, r2);
                total = chosen + mod;
                rolls = [r1, r2];
                detailsStr = `2d20 con Svantaggio (${r1}, ${r2}) ${mod &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;= 0 ? '+' : ''}${mod}`;
            } else {
                for (let i = 0; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; count; i++) {
                    const r = rollDiceValue(sides);
                    rolls.push(r);
                    total += r;
                }
                total += mod;
                detailsStr = `${count}d${sides} (${rolls.join(', ')}) ${mod &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;= 0 ? '+' : ''}${mod}`;
            }

            displayDiceResult(total, detailsStr);
            addDiceHistory(`${count}d${sides}${mod !== 0 ? (mod &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; 0 ? '+'+mod : mod) : ''}`, total, rolls);
        }

        function displayDiceResult(val, details) {
            const valEl = document.getElementById('dice-result-val');
            const detEl = document.getElementById('dice-result-details');
            
            valEl.innerText = val;
            detEl.innerText = details;

            valEl.classList.remove('animate-roll');
            void valEl.offsetWidth; // trigger reflow
            valEl.classList.add('animate-roll');
        }

        function addDiceHistory(label, result, rolls) {
            diceHistory.unshift({ label, result, rolls, time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour: '2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}) });
            if (diceHistory.length &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; 25) diceHistory.pop();
            renderDiceHistory();
        }

        function renderDiceHistory() {
            const listEl = document.getElementById('dice-history-list');
            if (diceHistory.length === 0) {
                listEl.innerHTML = `&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="text-center text-fantasy-muted text-xs py-8"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;Nessun tiro effettuato.&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;`;
                return;
            }

            listEl.innerHTML = diceHistory.map(item =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; `
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="bg-fantasy-bg border border-fantasy-border p-3 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between text-xs"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span class="font-bold text-fantasy-gold block"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;${item.label}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span class="text-[10px] text-fantasy-muted"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;${item.time}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="font-cinzel text-lg font-bold text-white"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        ${item.result}
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            `).join('');
        }

        function clearDiceHistory() {
            diceHistory = [];
            renderDiceHistory();
        }


        /* ================= 2. INITIATIVE TRACKER ================= */
        let combatants = [];
        let currentTurnIndex = -1;
        let combatRound = 1;

        function handleAddCombatant(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const name = document.getElementById('comb-name').value;
            const init = parseInt(document.getElementById('comb-init').value) || 0;
            const hp = parseInt(document.getElementById('comb-hp').value) || 10;
            const type = document.getElementById('comb-type').value;

            combatants.push({
                id: Date.now(),
                name,
                init,
                hp,
                maxHp: hp,
                type
            });

            document.getElementById('comb-name').value = '';
            sortInitiative();
        }

        function sortInitiative() {
            combatants.sort((a, b) =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; b.init - a.init);
            if (currentTurnIndex === -1 &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; combatants.length &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; 0) {
                currentTurnIndex = 0;
            }
            renderCombatants();
        }

        function nextTurn() {
            if (combatants.length === 0) return;
            currentTurnIndex++;
            if (currentTurnIndex &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;= combatants.length) {
                currentTurnIndex = 0;
                combatRound++;
            }
            renderCombatants();
        }

        function changeHp(id, delta) {
            const c = combatants.find(item =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; item.id === id);
            if (c) {
                c.hp = Math.max(0, c.hp + delta);
                renderCombatants();
            }
        }

        function removeCombatant(id) {
            combatants = combatants.filter(item =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; item.id !== id);
            if (currentTurnIndex &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;= combatants.length) {
                currentTurnIndex = Math.max(0, combatants.length - 1);
            }
            renderCombatants();
        }

        function resetCombat() {
            combatants = [];
            currentTurnIndex = -1;
            combatRound = 1;
            renderCombatants();
        }

        function renderCombatants() {
            document.getElementById('combat-round').innerText = combatRound;
            document.getElementById('combat-count').innerText = combatants.length;

            const activeNameEl = document.getElementById('current-turn-name');
            if (combatants.length &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; 0 &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; currentTurnIndex &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;= 0) {
                activeNameEl.innerText = combatants[currentTurnIndex].name;
            } else {
                activeNameEl.innerText = 'Nessuno';
            }

            const listEl = document.getElementById('combatants-list');
            if (combatants.length === 0) {
                listEl.innerHTML = `&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="text-center text-fantasy-muted text-xs py-10"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;Nessun partecipante in combattimento.&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;`;
                return;
            }

            listEl.innerHTML = combatants.map((c, idx) =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; {
                const isActive = idx === currentTurnIndex;
                const hpPercent = Math.round((c.hp / c.maxHp) * 100);
                
                let badgeColor = 'bg-blue-950 text-blue-300 border-blue-800';
                if (c.type === 'enemy') badgeColor = 'bg-rose-950 text-rose-300 border-rose-800';
                if (c.type === 'ally') badgeColor = 'bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-800';

                return `
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="p-3 rounded-xl border transition-all ${isActive ? 'bg-fantasy-hover border-fantasy-gold shadow-lg ring-1 ring-fantasy-gold/50' : 'bg-fantasy-bg border-fantasy-border'} flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="flex items-center space-x-3 w-full sm:w-auto"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-fantasy-border font-cinzel text-fantasy-gold font-bold flex items-center justify-center text-sm"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                ${c.init}
                            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="flex items-center space-x-2"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span class="font-bold text-white text-sm"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;${c.name}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span class="text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded border ${badgeColor} font-semibold uppercase"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;${c.type}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="w-32 bg-fantasy-border h-1.5 rounded-full mt-1.5 overflow-hidden"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="bg-fantasy-crimson h-full transition-all" style="width: ${hpPercent}%"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;

                        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="flex items-center justify-between sm:justify-end w-full sm:w-auto space-x-3"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="flex items-center space-x-1"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="changeHp(${c.id}, -5)" class="w-6 h-6 bg-fantasy-border hover:bg-fantasy-crimson rounded text-white text-xs"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;-5&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="changeHp(${c.id}, -1)" class="w-6 h-6 bg-fantasy-border hover:bg-fantasy-crimson rounded text-white text-xs"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;-1&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span class="text-xs font-bold w-12 text-center text-white"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;${c.hp}/${c.maxHp}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="changeHp(${c.id}, 1)" class="w-6 h-6 bg-fantasy-border hover:bg-emerald-800 rounded text-white text-xs"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;+1&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="changeHp(${c.id}, 5)" class="w-6 h-6 bg-fantasy-border hover:bg-emerald-800 rounded text-white text-xs"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;+5&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="removeCombatant(${c.id})" class="text-fantasy-muted hover:text-rose-400 text-xs p-1"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-trash"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                            &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                `;
            }).join('');
        }


        /* ================= 3. NPC &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; NAME GENERATOR ================= */
        const nameData = {
            human: {
                male: ["Alistair", "Bram", "Cedric", "Gareth", "Julian", "Lucan", "Roderick", "Tristan"],
                female: ["Adelaide", "Beatrix", "Clara", "Evelyn", "Genevieve", "Isolda", "Mireia", "Rosalind"],
                surname: ["Blackwood", "Ironhart", "Vane", "Sterling", "Crowley", "Oakhaven", "Winter"]
            },
            elf: {
                male: ["Aerendil", "Caelynn", "Faelar", "Galanodel", "Ilonis", "Lorian", "Saelorn", "Thalor"],
                female: ["Aria", "Caeda", "Elysia", "Lethien", "Lyra", "Naerwen", "Saria", "Valerius"],
                surname: ["Moonwhisper", "Starweaver", "Sunshadow", "Windrunner", "Silversong"]
            },
            dwarf: {
                male: ["Balthor", "Durnim", "Eldrin", "Gimrak", "Kargrim", "Thorin", "Thrumkell", "Varok"],
                female: ["Bardryn", "Dagnal", "Helja", "Kilia", "Liftrasa", "Torbera", "Vondra"],
                surname: ["Bronzebeard", "Ironfist", "Stoneforge", "Deepdelver", "Goldhammer"]
            },
            orc: {

                female: ["Brakka", "Gharsha", "Kasha", "Mogrash", "Oruka", "Shautha", "Usha"],
                surname: ["Bloodjaw", "Skullcrusher", "Ironhide", "Bonebreaker", "Doomhammer"]
            }

        const npcRoles = ["Mercante Ambiguo", "Guardia della Citta", "Nobile Decaduto", "Spia di Fazione", "Accademico dell'Arcano", "Locandiere Chiacchierone", "Mercenario in Congedo"];
        const npcTraits = ["Estremamente cauto e diffidente", "Maniacalmente formale ed educato", "Parla a bassa voce guardandosi sempre attorno", "Incredibilmente allegro nonostante i pericoli", "Sempre distratto e con la testa tra le nuvole"];
        const npcMotives = ["Pagare un vecchio debito di gioco", "Rintracciare un parente scomparso", "Accumulare ricchezze per comprare un titolo", "Proteggere un antico segreto di famiglia", "Ottenere vendetta su un rivale locale"];
        const npcFlaws = ["Non riesce a mantenere un segreto se corrotto con dell'ottimo vino", "Troppo orgoglioso per ammettere di aver sbagliato", "Nasconde una maledizione latente", "Ha il terrore viscerale dei luoghi chiusi"];

        function getRandomItem(arr) {
            return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];
        }

        function generateNamesList() {
            const race = document.getElementById('name-race').value;
            const genderSelect = document.getElementById('name-gender').value;
            const data = nameData[race];

            let names = [];
            for (let i = 0; i &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt; 5; i++) {
                let gender = genderSelect;
                if (gender === 'any') gender = Math.random() &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; 0.5 ? 'male' : 'female';
                const first = getRandomItem(data[gender]);
                const last = getRandomItem(data.surname);
                names.push(`${first} ${last}`);
            }

            const listEl = document.getElementById('names-output-list');
            listEl.innerHTML = names.map(n =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; `
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;div class="p-2 bg-fantasy-bg border border-fantasy-border rounded-lg text-sm text-fantasy-text flex items-center justify-between"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;${n}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="navigator.clipboard.writeText('${n}')" class="text-xs text-fantasy-muted hover:text-fantasy-gold p-1"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                        &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-copy"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/div&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            `).join('');
        }

        let currentNPC = null;

        function generateFullNPC() {
            const races = ['human', 'elf', 'dwarf', 'orc'];
            const race = getRandomItem(races);
            const gender = Math.random() &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; 0.5 ? 'male' : 'female';
            const first = getRandomItem(nameData[race][gender]);
            const last = getRandomItem(nameData[race].surname);
            
            currentNPC = {
                name: `${first} ${last}`,
                role: `${getRandomItem(npcRoles)} (${race.toUpperCase()})`,
                trait: getRandomItem(npcTraits),
                motive: getRandomItem(npcMotives),
                flaw: getRandomItem(npcFlaws)
            };

            document.getElementById('npc-res-name').innerText = currentNPC.name;
            document.getElementById('npc-res-role').innerText = currentNPC.role;
            document.getElementById('npc-res-trait').innerText = currentNPC.trait;
            document.getElementById('npc-res-motive').innerText = currentNPC.motive;
            document.getElementById('npc-res-flaw').innerText = currentNPC.flaw;

            document.getElementById('npc-card-result').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.getElementById('save-npc-btn-wrap').classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        function copyNpcToClipboard() {
            if (!currentNPC) return;
            const text = `NPG: ${currentNPC.name}\nRuolo: ${currentNPC.role}\nPersonalità: ${currentNPC.trait}\nObiettivo: ${currentNPC.motive}\nDifetto/Segreto: ${currentNPC.flaw}`;
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
            alert("Scheda NPG copiata negli appunti!");
        }


        /* ================= 4. DM SCRATCHPAD (LOCAL STORAGE) ================= */
        let notes = [];
        let activeNoteId = null;

        function loadNotes() {
            const saved = localStorage.getItem('ttrpg_dm_notes');
            if (saved) {
                try {
                    notes = JSON.parse(saved);
                } catch(e) {
                    notes = [];
                }
            }

            if (notes.length === 0) {
                notes = [{
                    id: Date.now(),
                    title: "Appunti Prima Sessione",
                    content: "Benvenuto nel tuo Scratchpad DM!\n\n- Qui puoi annotare nomi di Taverne, spunti di trama improvvisati o promemoria.\n- Le note si salvano automaticamente nel tuo browser."
                }];
                saveNotesToStorage();
            }

            activeNoteId = notes[0].id;
            renderNotesSidebar();
            loadActiveNoteIntoEditor();
        }

        function saveNotesToStorage() {
            localStorage.setItem('ttrpg_dm_notes', JSON.stringify(notes));
        }

        function renderNotesSidebar() {
            const sidebar = document.getElementById('notes-sidebar-list');
            sidebar.innerHTML = notes.map(n =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; `
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;button onclick="selectNote(${n.id})" class="w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold transition-all truncate block ${n.id === activeNoteId ? 'bg-fantasy-crimson text-white shadow' : 'text-fantasy-muted hover:bg-fantasy-hover hover:text-white'}"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines mr-2"&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/i&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                    &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;${n.title || 'Senza Titolo'}&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/span&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
                &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;/button&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;
            `).join('');
        }

        function selectNote(id) {
            activeNoteId = id;
            renderNotesSidebar();
            loadActiveNoteIntoEditor();
        }

        function loadActiveNoteIntoEditor() {
            const note = notes.find(n =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; n.id === activeNoteId);
            if (!note) return;

            document.getElementById('note-title-input').value = note.title;
            document.getElementById('note-content-input').value = note.content;
            updateCharCount();
        }

        function saveCurrentNote() {
            const note = notes.find(n =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; n.id === activeNoteId);
            if (!note) return;

            note.title = document.getElementById('note-title-input').value;
            note.content = document.getElementById('note-content-input').value;

            saveNotesToStorage();
            renderNotesSidebar();
            updateCharCount();
        }

        function createNewNote() {
            const newNote = {
                id: Date.now(),
                title: "Nuova Nota",
                content: ""
            };
            notes.unshift(newNote);
            activeNoteId = newNote.id;
            saveNotesToStorage();
            renderNotesSidebar();
            loadActiveNoteIntoEditor();
        }

        function deleteCurrentNote() {
            if (notes.length &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;= 1) {
                alert("Devi mantenere almeno una nota!");
                return;
            }
            notes = notes.filter(n =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; n.id !== activeNoteId);
            activeNoteId = notes[0].id;
            saveNotesToStorage();
            renderNotesSidebar();
            loadActiveNoteIntoEditor();
        }

        function updateCharCount() {
            const content = document.getElementById('note-content-input').value;
            document.getElementById('note-char-count').innerText = `${content.length} caratteri`;
        }

        function openExportModal() {

        function switchExportTab(fileName) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.exp-tab').forEach(t =&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt; {
                t.classList.remove('bg-fantasy-hover', 'text-fantasy-gold', 'font-bold');
                t.classList.add('text-fantasy-muted');
            });
            const activeTab = document.getElementById(`exp-tab-${fileName}`);
            if (activeTab) {
                activeTab.classList.add('bg-fantasy-hover', 'text-fantasy-gold', 'font-bold');
                activeTab.classList.remove('text-fantasy-muted');
            }

            const codeBox = document.getElementById('export-code-box');
            codeBox.textContent = `&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;lt;!-- ${fileName}.html per GitHub Pages --&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;gt;\n` + document.documentElement.outerHTML;
        }

        function copyExportCode() {
            const code = document.getElementById('export-code-box').textContent;
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
            alert("Codice HTML copiato negli appunti!");
        }
